rationale: Choose the registered structure family because it combines ligand-coordinate anchoring with receptor-contact and clash terms, keeping a multimodal geometric objective tied to a real bound conformation instead of averaging separate feature targets into unsupported geometry. The ligand and receptor coordinates originate from the original common bound structure, not generated Steer history. Set time_ramp_power to 0 because selected endpoint, parent-edge, and survival results do not establish a temporal rule. The selected weights are a bounded prospective geometry hypothesis; the supplied associations do not identify causal parameter values, and this objective is not an affinity energy.
failure_modes: The bound structure may overconstrain conformational changes that improve predicted pIC50.
Contact and repulsion terms are geometric proxies and do not measure binding affinity.
The selected evidence is compressed and observational, with no parameter-response results or experimental affinity validation.
Combining anchor, contact, and repulsion terms may trade off orientation, clashes, strain, and predicted pIC50 in ways not captured by the evidence.
